title: "01 - EDA"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
source("scripts/utils/data_loader.R")
core <- load_core_data(getwd())
```

## Portfolio Overview

```{r}
core$policies %>% summarise(
  policy_count = n_distinct(policy_id),
  total_payroll = sum(payroll),
  avg_employees = mean(employees)
)
```

## Claim Frequency Distribution

```{r}
freq <- core$claims %>% count(policy_id, name = "claim_count")
ggplot(freq, aes(x = claim_count)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "#355070", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Claim Frequency Distribution")
```

## Claim Severity Distribution

```{r}
ggplot(core$claims, aes(x = ultimate_loss)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "#6d597a", color = "white") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(title = "Claim Severity (log scale)")
```

## Industry Mix

```{r}
core$policies %>%
  count(naics_description, sort = TRUE) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(naics_description, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#b56576") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "NAICS Portfolio Composition", x = NULL, y = "Policy count")
```
